fixes.problem: PARTIAL IMPROVEMENT, STILL FAILING. Measured over 22,118 transitions of >=18 LSB across six probe regions: median boundary width rose from round 4's 2.0 px to 3.0 px and the fraction completing in <=2 px fell from 0.55-0.62 to 0.33-0.46. An identical constant on skin, wool, steel, stone and mud is a post-process blur radius, not pigment creeping into cold-press fibre. Real watercolour band edges vary in width by material absorbency and wobble in CONTOUR; none of these do.
fixes.change: Make the wet term span 5-9 screen px and scale with the step it crosses: wetBands = (warp-0.5)*2.0*clamp(dPerPx*uWetPx,0.0,1.6)*uBandBleed*(0.5+1.5*abs(bandStep)), and drive warp from a 2-octave fbm at 0.006 world units so the boundary CONTOUR wobbles +/-4 px, not just softens. Give each material family its own uBandBleed (skin 1.6, wool 2.2, steel 1.2, earth 2.4) so the median width differs by >=1.5 px between families. Verification: median boundary width >= 5.0 px, frac <=2 px < 0.20 on all six regions, and the six regional medians must span at least 3 px end to end instead of being identically 3.0.

Measured: bldgA roof (UP-facing, x1205-1315 y85-150) lum 145.3, against its lit SW wall (VERTICAL, x1110-1190 y180-255) 173.0 and even its shaded SE wall (VERTICAL, x1215-1330 y185-232) 151.5 — the roof is darker than BOTH verticals. bldgB roof (x1255-1455 y215-285) 165.9 against its lit S wall (x1270-1430 y300-375) 180.9 — again the up-facing plane loses. The only surviving directional cue is albedo: the 'shaded' SE wall measures hue 20, HSL sat 0.17, B-R = -34.4, i.e. still RED-dominant, so it is a desaturated warm face, not a violet-shifted one; the lit/shade delta on bldgA is 21.5 lum = 15% of the world's 143-lum p1-p99 range. No vehicle is present in this frame to test, so the round-5 'vehicles get no directional light' fix is unverifiable here; on the two visible characters the interior alternates 56<->160 pixel to pixel, so no lit side versus shaded side exists to measure.
fixes.change: Separate the sky term from the sun term in the `drive` computation: drive = NdotL*sunI + max(0.0, N.y)*skyI with skyI >= 0.42*sunI, instead of the current single hemispheric wrap. Verify: on every solid in frame the up-facing plane must exceed its own brightest vertical by >=12 lum (roof 145.3 -> >=185 against wall 173.0), the two opposing verticals of the same building must differ by >=35 lum, and the darker of the pair must land hue >240 deg with B-R >= +6 (currently hue 20, B-R -34.4).
